messages:
morgan: heads-up: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/482 — small module split + surface cleanup. needs extra eyes on export shapes and import ordering. cc @alex @renee :eyes:
alex: taking a look now. can you add a short summary at the top of the PR about the module boundaries you changed? makes reviews easier.
morgan: done — added a "module boundary" section and a short rationale for moving helpers -> core-utils. also ran `yarn lint --fix` but left two style warnings (couldn't auto-fix). snippet: ```
src/core-utils/index.ts: line 12: prefer default export over named when single export
src/serializers/serialize.ts: line 47: prefer const over let
```
renee: quick scan — overall looks good. one functional concern: `getConfigForEnv` mutates the default config object, which can leak between calls. can you return a shallow clone e.g. `return {...config}` or `deepClone(config)`?
chao: i can do a proper pass after lunch. if this is mostly reorg + renames i'm 👍 pending the config immutability fix and tests. can you also add a small changelog entry so the internal deploy notes show the refactor? small refactors surface later during audits.
morgan: added unit tests for the moved helpers and added changelog entry at `docs/changes/2026-03-17-module-surface-cleanup.md`. updated `getConfigForEnv` to return a shallow clone. CI ran locally: `✅ unit-tests 48 passed` — pushing now.
ci-bot: build #482.1: checks passed — all jobs green. merge queue: clear. :white_check_mark:
alex: thanks everyone. i'll merge after the canary window (4pm PT) and monitor logs for any import path regressions. nice cleanup, @morgan :tada:
morgan: thanks! ping if anything odd on canary, i'll stand by to revert.
